messages:
marie: quick flag — noticed two small regressions in console/observability docs: Python SDK example omits the trace header and the dashboard JSON still references the old metric name. can we patch before Monday?

sam: can you paste the exact snippets you found?

marie: the Python snippet currently is:

```python
client = Redwood(api_key=KEY)
```

li: easy fix — add the header so trace keys map correctly:

```python
client = Redwood(api_key=KEY, headers={"x-redwood-tracekey": trace.id})
```

marie: the dashboard JSON has:

```json
{"metric": "cost.breakdown.v1", "group_by": ["session_id"]}
```

sam: change metric to `cost.unit.v2` and add a one-line migration note about the aggregation semantics (per-token -> per-unit) so users updating queries understand the delta.

docs-bot: lint queued for PR. linkcheck reports a 301 from https://docs.internal/redwood/old-metrics -> /telemetry/migrations. please update absolute links.

li: i'll open a small docs PR with the Python header addition, dashboard metric change, and a tiny compatibility table (old -> new metric names + example query). PTAL: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/9401

sam: preview deployed: https://preview.docs.redwood/9401 — i will run a quick smoke on dashboards after merge.

docs-bot: CI passed. preview available.

li: merged and deployed to production docs.

sam: monitored the alerts for 30m; no regression and trace correlation looks correct in the cost dashboard.

marie: thanks everyone :tada: this should prevent further per-session double-counting issues.
